text: これは　ポケモンの　れきしに　のこる　いだいな　しごとじゃー！

structure.jp: ポケモンの　れきしに　のこる
structure.en: that will remain in Pokémon history

structure.jp: いだいな　しごとじゃー！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: れきしに　のこる　いだいな　しごと
patterns.explanation: A plain verb before a noun describes it. のこる　しごと = 'a job that remains'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the old-man form of だ, stretched for emphasis. しごとじゃー = 'it is a job!'.
